Shanghai, 19th July, 1929.

（批：This case is set for hearing on 6-9-29 at 9 am. Please reply）

Commissioner of Police,
(Capt. Springfield).
--------

Dear Sir,

Brandt & Rodgers, Ltd.
-and-
Ta Lu University - 139 Gordon Road.

Confirming our recent interview with Capt. Springfield, we have informed you of the action now pending in the Shanghai Provisional Court in which our clients, Messrs. Brandt & Rodgers, Ltd., Lessors of the above premises, are claiming arrears of rent and for possession.

$400.00 is now due, and probably the August rent will also be lost, unless the trial intervenes.

You have taken over the furniture in the premises on 13th July, and have agreed to let the Court decide whether our claim is to have priority over the claims of the Police. We have filed a Motion asking for early hearing and for a decision on this point, and will supply you with a copy if you wish.

（批：a/c.p.
I instructed AM on 13th to hold furniture pending further instructions）

Yours faithfully,

AMP/CCC

'JUL 19 1929
a.s.c.
（批：ask Court to let us know when motion is set for hearing）
JUL 19 1929

South China University Self Protection Movement
Committee's letter to brethren.
----

Under the name of Communism, a number of enthusiastic
youth have lost their lives. Our school whose students
and teachers have so far not participated in any political
movement, has suffered the same fate as the Continental
University and Kiu Hwa Middle School under the charge of
"Being Communistic with evidence proof". After a
thorough consideration} we can not find out the proof
ourselves.

Our school had been searched for three times; the first
time on the forenoon of April 12, the second time, on
the afternoon of the same day, and the third time on the
evening of May 8. The first time the search party
took away a number of books which the Students Union
had bought from various stores for sale to students.
These include World History, and other scientific books,
numbering altogether 126 copies. They found nothing on
the second visit, and on the third time they seized
a manifesto issued by our Students' Union in connection
with the false accusation, a circular sent out by the
May Revolutionary Anniversary Commemoration Committee and
administering a draft book. Brethren, from these things,
how can you expect to find the proof of being communistic.
Such kind of unreasonable oppression upon the populace
is far more severe
than those of Militarists such as Sun Chuan Fang, and Chang
Tso-ling. As a matter of fact, they can seal or kill anyone
whenever they like, no matter whether he is communist

华南大学自保运动委员会致同仁书。
----

在共产主义的名义下，许多热血青年丧失了生命。我校师生迄今未参与任何政治运动，却与大夏大学（Continental University）及暨南中学（Kiu Hwa Middle School）遭遇相同命运，被指控“有确凿证据表明从事共产主义活动”。经彻底考量，我方自行查证，并未发现此类证据。

我校已遭搜查三次；第一次在4月12日上午，第二次在同日下午，第三次在5月8日晚。第一次搜查时，搜查队拿走了学生会从各家书店购买并拟售予学生的多批书籍。其中包括《世界史》及其他科学类书籍，共计126册。第二次搜查一无所获，第三次则查获我校学生会就上述诬告一事发布的宣言一份、五月革命周年纪念委员会发出的通告一份，以及草稿簿一册。同仁们，从这些物品中，你们如何能找出从事共产主义活动的证据呢？这种对民众毫无道理的压迫，远比孙传芳、张作霖等军阀的行径更为严酷。事实上，他们可以随时查封或杀害任何人，无论其是否为共产党员！

page_data.en:
Brethren! Have not we, young men, come from distant
places of 1,000 li away to Shanghai with the object
of getting a bit of new knowledge by study. Therefore
we hoped to get a school, and when we got it we
desire to bestow tender care to this school. We
remained there quietly to study only. We expected
that some men would come to investigate into the
case and deal with it according to law. Ah!
We are too bookish. The more we have kept quiet, the
more ferocious are the external oppression. "Might
is right" is truly a maxim. Facts have told us that
that investigation would reveal the truth is non-
existent. It is useless to ask for the protection of
law. Let us put forth our own strength to find a
way out. We feel that this matter does concern the
South China University only; it is also a strange phenomenon
of the Society. Who have no children? Who have no
inclination for study? Who have not a few new books?
Who do not commemorate the National Disgrace Day? To
possess a few new books will cause a school to be sealed
up. Then what books shall we study? To commemorate
the National disgrace will cause a school to seal up.
Then what is the use to study? To-day they sealed
up three schools, and then they can seal others tomorrow.
If we remain quiet and do not rise up to fight for our
rights—freedom of study and of thinking, where can we
in which
find place to live, and what schools can we study?!
Brethren! Rise up and support us to struggle for
freedom of study and thinking! Oppose the unreasonable
oppression from political point of view?

（签名）
MAY 1st 1925
page_data.zh:
同胞们！难道我们这些青年，不是从千里之外的远方来到上海，旨在通过研习获取些许新知识吗？因此，我们渴望拥有一所学校，而当学校成立后，我们愿对其倍加呵护。我们留在那里，只是安静地求学。我们曾指望有人前来调查此案，并依法处置。唉！
我们太过书生气。我们越是保持沉默，外来的压迫便越是凶残。“强权即公理”确是一句箴言。事实告诉我们，那种能揭示真相的调查根本不存在。寻求法律保护毫无用处。让我们依靠自身的力量，寻找出路。我们感到，此事不仅关乎华南大学（South China University）；它也是社会上的一种怪现象。谁没有子女？谁没有求学的志向？谁没有几本新书？谁不纪念国耻日？拥有几本新书竟会导致学校被封。那么我们该读什么书？纪念国耻竟会导致学校被封。那么读书又有何用？今天他们查封了三所学校，明天就可能查封其他学校。
如果我们保持沉默，不起而为我们的权利——求学与思想自由——抗争，我们将何处安身，又能在哪些学校求学？！
同胞们！奋起支持我们，为求学与思想自由而斗争！反对来自政治方面的无理压迫？

（签名）
1925年5月1日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.I.D REGISTRY
No. I. C. S. 110
Date..19..5..29..

Between 9 and 11 p.m. on May 8 the Municipal
Police searched on Provisional Court warrant the following
educational institutions which were suspected of being at
the bottom of the anti-Government movement:- (See D.R. 96)
*See file D.174
Ta Lu University, 139 Gordon Road, Kien Hua
Middle School, 79 Sinza Road and Hua Nan University, 105
Avenue Road.

In a room of the first mentioned establishment
were found a small hand press together with anti-Government
handbills, the ink of which was still wet, and a large
supply of blank paper. The arrival of the Police on the
University premises had evidently disturbed the printers
who vacated the room and intermingled with students in the
compound. It was quite clear that preparations for to-day's
meeting, to which reference is made in the literature, were
in full swing and the fact that none of the usual anniversary
posters appeared during the night points to this institution
as being responsible to a great extent for the issue of
literature on the occasion of May anniversaries.

In the Kien Hua and Hua Nan establishments, there
was no activity and the nett seizure in each case was a
draft document attacking the Government.

This literature was brought before the Provisional
Court this morning, when the following decision was rendered.
" The premises of all three institutions to be sealed up and
the property therein to be confiscated and held in the
premises for 10 days and if no application is made within
that time by responsible persons for release of the property
the Court's order is to be carried out in full."

在上述第一所机构的一间房间内，发现了一台小型手摇印刷机，连同墨迹未干的反政府传单，以及大量空白纸张。警察抵达该大学校舍显然惊动了印刷人员，他们离开房间并混入校园内的学生之中。很明显，文献中提及的当日集会的准备工作正在紧锣密鼓地进行，而夜间未出现任何通常的周年纪念海报这一事实，表明该机构在很大程度上负责发布五月周年纪念期间的宣传品。

Sir,
With reference to the enclosed Court Order No.364-C
for the sealing of the premises of the Hua Nan University, I have
to point out for your consideration that this Order has been issued
without any proceedings in Court ordering the sealing of the Hua
Nan University.

On April 13, the Police made an application before
Judge Blunt with Mr. Hasegawa sitting as Deputy, for the disposal
of certain literature removed by the Police from the premises of
the Hua Nan University. On that occasion the only order of the
Court was that the books seized there should be confiscated. To
this Order the Principal of the University was entirely agreeable.
I would suggest for your consideration, the desirability of a
summons being issued against the Principal to show cause why the
premises should not be sealed. Thereafter, it would be in order
for the Court to issue sealing orders, but I think you will agree
with me that sealing orders of an ex parte nature without Court
proceedings are irregular.

I return the Court Order and Sealing Orders herewith.

Yours faithfully,

(Sd) R.M.I. Martin

A/D.C.I.,
The Principal of the Hua Nan University handed over
the books to the Police before the search warrant was
received, and intimated his willingness to refrain from
using or keeping in the University any books to which the
Police objected. Therefore in ordering the confiscation
of the books, it might be fairly claimed that the Court
was simply carrying out the Principal's wishes. Under
these circumstances the issuance of an order for the sealing
up of the school amounts to persecution. While it is
probably true that the persons controlling the policy of the
school differ politically from the National Government there
is no evidence available that they are Communists and the
action taken by them in the present case clearly demonstrate
that they are anxious to co-operate with the Police.
Further the building is probably foreign property,
and it is doubtful if the Provisional Court has the right to
interfere with it without the sanction of the owner's consul.
As a matter of general principle, I would recommend
that the Council extend protection to all individuals and
enterprises within the Settlement, which obey the laws and
regulations of the Settlement, While the Kuomintang expects

根据大上海市政府的请求，并遵照教育部来函，称上海华南大学是宣传共产主义文学的宣传部门，该案已由教育局（大上海市政府）调查，遂签发搜查令，警方于本月12日对该处所进行了搜查。根据新闸捕房探长在4月13日向法庭提交的报告，警方收到一份传单，暗示华南大学是以学校为掩护的共产党宣传部门，并在4月12日搜查时发现了124本具有共产主义色彩的书籍。同日下午收到搜查令并进行了第二次搜查，但未发现任何物品。为压制反国民党反应，申请并获准没收这些书籍的命令。本庭进一步查明，该大学被报告给国民党中央总部，称其为由两名名为李初黎（Li Tsao Lee）和王独清（Wong To-ching）的共产党人组织的共产主义宣传部门，并且他们使用了已被查封的创造社出版的教科书。因此，现签发十份查封华南大学的命令，警方需派遣侦探和巡捕据此行事，不得保留，并在回报时向法庭提交一份由此查封的家具、书籍、仪器等物品清单，以便处理。

April 19, 1929.
Provisional Court Order for the sealing
of the Hua Nan University, 105 Avenue Rd.
I learn that the notorious Chen Te-cheng (陳德徵), in his
new capacity as Chief of the Bureau of Education of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, is behind the issue of this
sealing order.
In view of the fact that the Court on April 13 saw fit
to close the case against this university by ordering the
destruction of the books, I fail to see why the Municipal
Police should be called upon to carry out an order which
does not appear to have necessitated even an ex-parte
application in Court to effect its issue and is, in fact,
sheer persecution of an institution whose teachers and pupils
have "left" leanings.
The statement in the order to the effect that application
was made for the destruction of the books is incorrect, as
the Municipal Police took into consideration the fact that
the majority of the publications were not over violent and
their discovery was due to the willingness on the part of
(the Police)
the Principal of the University to show them over the
establishment, and accordingly confined themselves to an
application for disposal of the books.
Jno Robertson
C. D. I.
A/D.C.I.
（批：I agree）

1929年4月19日。
临时法院查封爱文义路105号华南大学的命令。
我获悉，臭名昭著的陈德徵（Chen Te-cheng）以其大上海市政府教育局局长的新身份，是发布此查封令的背后推手。
鉴于法院在4月13日认为通过命令销毁书籍来结案是对该大学的适当处理，我不明白为何要要求市警察执行一项似乎甚至无需单方面向法院申请即可发布的命令，这实际上是对一所师生具有“左”倾倾向的机构的纯粹迫害。
命令中声称已申请销毁书籍的说法是不正确的，因为市警察考虑到大多数出版物并不过于激烈，且其被发现是由于大学校长愿意向警方展示整个机构，因此警方仅限于申请处理这些书籍。

April 13, 1929.

A/D.C.I.,

At 11.30 a.m. on April 12, in company with D.I.
Chen Chang, I visited the South China University at No.105
Avenue Road - the school mentioned in the attached translation
of a pamphlet issued by a certain "Chinese Association for
the Advancement of Civilization". In the course of an inter-
view, Fu Tsung-sien (傅震先), the principle, who is a native
of Nanchang and graduate of the Kyoto University, informed us
that his school was newly established on March 10 by one Li
Tsung-wu (李宗武) who is at present away from Shanghai. The
teachers number about 20 (list attached) while the number of
students is about 90, who hail from various provinces of the
country and of whom about 25 are living on the premises. Mr.
Fu, then showed us over the premises. In one of the upstairs
rooms, occupied by a member of the school staff named Liu Soo
(刘苏), a large quantity of books were found, some of which
on cursory inspection proved to be of a radical nature. Liu
the occupant of the room, explained that the books are the
property of the Students' Union of the school and are intended
by the Union for sale to students. I reported this matter to
Mr. Givens (A.C.Pol.) and on his instructions I sought Mr.
Fu's sanction to remove the books to Police Headquarters for
examination. Mr. Fu readily consented to this.

At 4.30 p.m. April 12, a search warrant was received at
Headquarters from the Provisional Court for the search of the
South China University for communistic literature. The search
was carried out between 5 and 7 p.m. April 12 by a party of
police under C.D.I. Robertson but nothing further was found.
These books were taken before the Provisional Court to-day
when an order for their destruction was made by Judge Hsiung
and Mr. Hasegawa.

1929年4月13日。

助理副侦探督察，

4月12日上午11时30分，我与侦探督察陈昌一同前往爱文义路105号的华南大学——即附译件中提到的由某“中华文明促进会”发布的小册子中所提及的学校。在交谈过程中，校长傅震先（傅震先）告知我们，他是南昌人，京都大学毕业。该校由李宗武（李宗武）于3月10日新近创办，李目前不在上海。教员约有20人（名单附后），学生约有90人，来自全国各地，其中约25人住在校内。随后，傅先生带领我们参观了校舍。在一间由名为刘苏（刘苏）的教职员占用的楼上房间里，发现了大量书籍，粗略检查显示其中一些具有激进性质。该房间占用者刘解释说，这些书籍属于学校学生会，由学生会打算出售给学生。我将此事报告给吉文斯先生（助理警务处长），并根据他的指示，征求傅先生的同意，将书籍移至警察总局进行检查。傅先生欣然同意。

4月12日下午4时30分，总局收到临时法院签发的搜查令，搜查华南大学的共产主义文献。搜查工作于4月12日下午5时至7时由副侦探督察罗伯逊率领的一队警察执行，但未发现其他物品。这些书籍今天被提交至临时法院，熊法官和长谷川先生下令将其销毁。

"Hua-Nan College", a Communistic Propaganda Organization; Should

The Association for the "Advancement of Civilisation" has
distributed printed handbills giving the following names of Com-
munists, viz: Wong Tu-ching (王 獨 清),
Li Ts'u-li (李 初 梨),

in the Shanghai College of Arts: (1) in promoting propaganda,
(but last year owing to the interference of French Police and the
detention of Students, this enterprise failed)and (2) in attempting
to obtain permission to re-open the General Propaganda Organiza-
tion of the "Creation Society", its office having been formally
closed;but in this they also failed. They then determined to
carry on and concentrated their energy and money to establish the
"Hua Nan College", the aim of which is obscure though the intention
was to employ young students for the purpose of propagating
communism. In consequence of their failure they dared not make
themselves known, therefore, they engaged one Li □□□u (李 □ □),
a person little known,as a tool to establish relations with other
people, and they engaged lawyers to influence the Settlement Police

中华“文明促进会”秘书李国光（李 國 光）发布的传单译文：
------------------ 1929年3月16日

“华南学院”，一个共产主义宣传组织；
是否应允许其存在？。
------------------

“文明促进会”散发了印刷传单，列出了以下共产党人的姓名，即：王独清（王 獨 清）、
李初梨（李 初 梨）、
冯乃超（馮 乃 超）、
王一榴（王 一 榴）、
彭康（彭 康）、
朱镜我（朱 鏡 我）以及
段可情（段 可 情）。

他们是“创造社”的成员，并在上海艺术大学积极活动：(1) 进行宣传（但去年由于法国警方的干预和学生被拘留，这项行动失败了）；(2) 试图获得许可重新开放“创造社”的总宣传机构，该机构的办事处已正式关闭；但在这方面他们也失败了。于是他们决定继续下去，集中精力和资金建立了“华南学院”，其目的虽然不明，但意图是利用青年学生来传播共产主义。由于他们的失败，他们不敢公开身份，因此雇佣了一个鲜为人知的人李□□□u（李 □ □）作为工具与他人建立联系，并聘请律师影响租界警方

page_data.en:
-2-

with the view of getting detectives and policemen to assist them.
Their object is thus very obvious. These communists of the
"Creation Society" need not necessarily be presidents of the
School, but they must be teachers, as otherwise the students
would not come under their influence. This alone is sufficient to
cause their expulsion and to mete out to them the punishment they
deserve. If the lair of wolves may be destroyed, should not the
wolves themselves be disposed of? The facts are known to the
community. If the people of the community are all so stupid as
not to remove the fuel, do they wish to allow the fire to spread?
Communism has been fierce and destructive for a long time. Massacre
is a very awkward matter. If educational and propaganda
organizations be not completely suppressed, numerous students,—the
young men and women of today,—will become the communists of
tomorrow. The Communists of the "Creation Society" are bold and
are not deterred by failure; they hold strongly to their purpose
and do not care what steps they take to attain it. But should
those who must heed the trend of public opinion, who control
education, and are the parents and elder brothers of the younger
generation to remain indifferent while the Communists spread their
evil influence?

Whether the funds of the "Hua Nan College" be sufficient
or not, its equipment be complete or not, its president qualified
or not, its teachers communistic or not, its curriculum adequate
or not, these are points that bear on the peace of the community.
Therefore, we must waken the attention of the Community to them,
and must urge the public and the authorities to adopt a firm
attitude against Communism.

(Signed and chopped) Li Kuo-Kuan.

（手写签名及日期：Li Kuo-Kuan 16 MAR 1929）
page_data.zh:
-2-

以期让侦探和警察协助他们。他们的目标 thus 非常明显。这些“创造社”的共产党人不一定非要是学校的校长，但必须是教师，否则学生就不会受到他们的影响。仅这一点就足以导致他们被驱逐，并使他们受到应有的惩罚。如果狼穴可以被摧毁，难道不应该处置狼本身吗？事实为社会所共知。如果社会大众都如此愚蠢，不去撤去柴火，难道他们希望火势蔓延吗？共产主义长期以来一直凶猛且具有破坏性。屠杀是一件非常棘手的事情。如果不彻底镇压教育和宣传组织，众多的学生——今天的青年男女——将成为明天的共产党人。“创造社”的共产党人大胆无畏，不因失败而退缩；他们坚定执着，不在乎采取何种手段来达到目的。但是，那些必须关注舆论导向、掌控教育、作为年轻一代父母兄长的人，难道应该在共产党人散布其邪恶影响时无动于衷吗？

无论“华南学院”的资金是否充足，设备是否完善，校长是否合格，教师是否具有共产主义倾向，课程是否充分，这些都是关乎社区安宁的问题。因此，我们必须唤起社区对这些问题的关注，并敦促公众和当局对共产主义采取强硬态度。

（签名并盖章）李国光。

（手写签名及日期：李国光 1929年3月16日）

副本
以期让巡捕和警探协助他们。他们的目标 thus 非常明显。这些“创造社”的共产党人未必一定是学校的校长，但必须是教师，否则学生就不会受到他们的影响。仅这一点就足以导致他们被驱逐，并使他们受到应有的惩罚。如果狼穴可以被摧毁，难道不应该处置狼本身吗？事实为社会所共知。如果社会民众都如此愚钝，不去撤去柴薪，难道他们希望火势蔓延吗？共产主义长期以来一直凶猛且具有破坏性。大屠杀是一件非常棘手的事情。如果不彻底镇压教育和宣传组织，众多的学生——即今天的青年男女——将成为明天的共产党人。“创造社”的共产党人胆大妄为，不因失败而退缩；他们 firmly 坚持其目的，不在乎采取何种手段来实现它。但是，那些必须关注舆论导向、掌控教育、作为年轻一代父母和兄长的人，难道应该在共产党人 spread 其邪恶影响时保持冷漠吗？

无论“南南学院”的资金是否充足，设备是否齐全，校长是否合格，教师是否为共产主义者，课程是否完备，这些都是关乎社区安宁的问题。因此，我们必须唤起社区对这些问题的关注，并敦促公众和当局对共产主义采取强硬态度。

（签名并盖章）李少棠（Li Shao-Tang）。

K/N
1928年3月16日
